source: Silverman, The arithmetic of elliptic curves, second edition, 2009
findings: VII.2.1 and VII.2.2 are stated for a minimal equation; the new text avoids applying that hypothesis at 2 and gives the integral formal-neighborhood argument.
Hasse uses the full group over F_p at split good primes, including infinity.
Formal isometry threshold is strict: r > v(p)/(p-1). Unramified r>=1 meets it for the consumed odd primes.
scope: Internal source inspection; not an independent human review or complete re-audit of the inherited manuscript.
